The concept of quantization in AI or specifically neural networks, is a technique to represent the weights, biases and activations in low-precision data types like 8-bit integer (int8) instead of the usual 32-bit floating point (float32).

On the other hand, for Post-training quantization(PTQ), the process happens after the model is trained. The steps involved are rounding of weights, biases or activations to a lower Precision. So if the original weights of the model are 32-bit floating point. This can be easily converted to a 8-bit integer type with PTQ.In this process, it computes scale after network has been trained.
